title: EnvironmentProfile
description: Output of the Environment Consistency Engine (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7). Tracks one persistent location/environment (a room, a street, a landscape) so weather, time of day, layout, and season stay coherent across every scene set there - avoiding impossible jumps like a sunny street becoming rainy at night one shot later with no narrative reason.

layout.description: Free-text room/street/geography layout description carried forward so later shots don't contradict established spatial relationships (e.g. 'door is stage-left of the window').

camera_geography_notes.description: Which direction is which within this environment (e.g. 'north wall faces the street'), so the Camera Continuity Engine can validate movement/angle changes stay geographically possible.
